source: Kempton et al. (2023), Nature 620, 67, 'A reflective, metal-rich atmosphere for GJ 1214b from its JWST phase curve' (doi:10.1038/s41586-023-06159-5; arXiv:2305.06240). JWST MIRI LRS phase curve of 20-22 July 2022, white light, 5.0-12.0 um. Values read from the authors' LaTeX source: Methods eq. 5 and the table of derived phase curve parameters (Extended Data Table 1), row 5.0-12.0, in ppm; the radius ratio from the authors' release (Zenodo record 7703086, 'Generate plots.ipynb').

model.equation: F_p = E + C1 (cos(omega t) - 1) + D1 sin(omega t) + C2 (cos(2 omega t) - 1) + D2 sin(2 omega t), t counted from mid-eclipse (Methods eq. 5); every term a fraction of the star's flux.

daysideK.where: abstract and main text: the dayside spectrum's average brightness temperature and best-fit blackbody

nightsideK.where: abstract: the nightside spectrum's average brightness temperature

offsetDegrees.cell: phi_med = -47.68 degrees: the phase of the first-order term, atan2(D_1, C_1), not the offset of the peak
